ideas.pitch: A Python and TypeScript tool designed to aggregate OSINT data across public platforms, automatically correlating EXIF metadata, social connection graphs, and username reuse to accelerate investigations during CTF rounds.
ideas.title: OSINT-Visualizer: Geolocation and Social Graph Correlation Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the OSINT challenge domain directly, this gives a competitive edge by automating tedious data aggregation tasks typical of hard and expert-tier jeopardy CTF problems.

ideas.pitch: An advanced Python-based toolkit utilizing pwntools to analyze binary security mitigations (NX, ASLR, RELRO) and automatically suggest or construct basic ROP chains for beginner to intermediate binary exploitation challenges.
ideas.title: HeapCraft: Automated Binary Exploitation and ROP Chain Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Binary exploitation and reverse engineering are high-value, low-solve-rate categories in jeopardy CTFs. A specialized automation tool directly assists with hard puzzles.

ideas.pitch: A Python library and web interface that identifies common cryptographic flaws (such as weak RSA exponents, ECB padding oracles, or improper IV reuse) and provides immediate automated decryption pipelines.
ideas.title: CryptoOracle: Automated Cryptographic Weakness Detection and Cipher Solver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Cryptography challenges often require repetitive mathematical checks. A rapid solver tool saves critical time during a 12-hour intense qualifier sprint.

ideas.pitch: A targeted web security scanner built in TypeScript designed to aggressively probe endpoints for JavaScript prototype pollution, insecure deserialization, and complex JWT signature bypass vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: WebScannerX: Automated Prototype Pollution and JWT Flaw Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Web exploitation is a staple of jeopardy CTFs; building a specialized tool helps rapidly surface obscure vulnerabilities often hidden in hard-tier web challenges.

ideas.pitch: A Python-based digital forensics utility designed to parse memory dumps, rapidly extract hidden network connections, unlinked DLLs, and injected shellcode signatures to solve DFIR challenges efficiently.
ideas.title: MemoryScope: Automated Volatile Memory Forensics and Artifact Extractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Digital forensics challenges require parsing large amounts of raw data under tight time constraints. Providing an automated triage workflow drastically improves solve speed.
